description: Pilot unseen-writer, text-independent IMU verification. Writer groups are disjoint; dev alone selects checkpoint and threshold; test is held out.
notes: Enrolled subjects must never be used in model training.
For each dev/test writer used as owner, the other dev/test writer serves as impostor; never use training writers as test impostors.
Enrollment and query never share a character for the same owner.
Target 5% FAR is exploratory, not a production mobile unlock security requirement.
All normalization and VAT thresholds must be fit on training writers only.
